Seventh TU reconstruction pilot (ov002/daChRoom_c). Reached TEXT-VERIFIED, 8/8 MATCH, objisolate clean. include/daChRoom_c.h was ALREADY a correctly-inheriting real header going in (struct daChRoom_c : dActor_c, real virtual dtor, real overrides) -- unlike daCamTag_c, no header edit was needed. Fixes applied: (1) the legacy D0 and D1 files each independently reconstructed the same `daChRoom_c::~daChRoom_c(){}` as a real out-of-line destructor -- a standard D0/D1 collapse (redefinition error), fixed by deleting one of the two duplicate bodies and letting the compiler emit both variants from the remaining one. (2) the now-familiar forced `+2` vtable addend on the factory's own vtable store, sixth confirmed occurrence with no exception across the series. (3) replaced Behavior()'s local shadow `struct Vec3 { Fix12i x,y,z; }` with the real project `Vector3` type (including the `(Vector3*)&mPosX` reinterpret-cast of the inherited position fields, matching the pattern documented in include/dActor_c.h itself) -- verified byte-identical before and after the swap; `Vector3`'s own empty `~Vector3(){}` is re-emitted in this TU's object as vague linkage, and it is now licensed rather than unschemable: compiler_only_output carries it as deadstrip-duplicate against the cartridge's one copy at arm9:0x020072c0.

PROMOTED, and the note above is kept for its history but is superseded on two points. (1) The coined name is gone: the class is daChRoom_c, read from ov002 0x021085b8's __si_class_type_info -- word [1] points at 0x021085c4 which holds exactly `10daChRoom_c`, word [2] at arm9 0x0208e390 which is _ZTI8dActor_c. An earlier sentence in note (1) -- deleted by the promotion commit rather than left in place, so do not go looking for it -- claimed a byte-length mismatch between the ROM's name and the decomp's; it read "a different string length than the decomp's daChRoom_c (11 chars)" after tools/class_rename.py substituted the new name into BOTH halves of it, leaving it comparing daChRoom_c to daChRoom_c and miscounting 10 characters as 11. There was never a mismatch, and the class's own _ZTI10daChRoom_c, _ZTS10daChRoom_c and _ZTV10daChRoom_c are therefore word-comparable against the cartridge and declared as deadstrip-data in compiler_only_output. (2) There is no D2 to deadstrip any more: the destructor moved inline into include/daChRoom_c.h, which is what puts D1 before D0 in ROM order and lets tools/objisolate.py accept the whole TU. The class is a leaf -- 0x021085b8 occurs at exactly one logical place under extracted/, its own vtable header at _ZTV-4 -- so no descendant exists that the inline body could be wrongly inlined into. The single canonical source is src/game/actors/d_a_ch_room.cpp, the snake_case stem tools/tu_names.py candidate_stem('daChRoom_c') produces.
